Correctly distinguished from #4507 (first dimension's guard blinded vs no guard existing). Not board material: pre-existing, unchanged mark count, authoring-time visibility gap rather than data understatement of drawn charts.

**ACCEPT — PR #4696** (reviewer of record; readings taken on GitHub at head `bf0d7351e`, matching the report's gate-union HEAD) **+ disposition of the open question.**

- **Shape**: draft → `main`, first line **`Fixes #4683`** — the only closing keyword; #4507 / #4692 / #4695 / #4487 all referenced bare.
- **Scope** (3 files): the renderer guard + its 11-case test + a real changeset; core read-only (no helper needed), #4694's click-handler region untouched — exactly the claim.
- **The signal is the right one, for the reason that matters**: `buildChartSeries`' own `series: []`-with-rows output, never `groupKey in row` — the #4507 trap inverted (pivoted bucket rows carry group VALUES as columns; a key-in-row test would refuse every grouped chart in the product). The refusal family is **measured** narrower than `CATEGORY_AXIS_CHART_TYPES` (pie/donut/funnel/radar/scatter/treemap/sankey fall back and draw — refusing there would blank good charts), and the difference is load-bearing.
- **Honesty boundaries surfaced, not papered over**: the copy does not name the missing key because the renderer measurably cannot know it (two byte-identical upstream shapes), so it names the failure and BOTH causes, with the diagnostic pair in the warn; `series === undefined` left byte-identical and PINNED so it cannot later read as silent contradiction (#4695).
- **The three-way distinction pinned on every arm**, with partial projection decided by mirroring the first dimension's measured precedent (not-one-row refuses; partial draws), the cross-guard precedence pinned, and the copy convention (hardcoded English, like the model) measured before writing — which made the i18n gates load-bearing greens.
- **Evidence**: 117 files / 2073 tests + 58/462 downstream by name; the zero-match trap fired for real and was caught out loud; reverse verification predicted exactly 3 red / 13 green including the one green-either-way case named as such; the flake attributed to #4487 with both-sides measurement and attached, not re-filed. All discipline points, hit.

**Open question ruled (delegated; veto window open): Option A stands, and B/C are declined — not deferred.** The dev's own three-axis analysis is the ruling's basis: B trades a guard that cannot be blinded for one that every present and future call site must remember to feed — the exact blindable-guard class #4507 records — and under B the DatasetWidget path (no `dimensions` on its chart schema) would keep saying nothing until someone noticed. The warn already carries the diagnostic pair; one nicer noun in one sentence does not buy back a blindable guard. If key-level naming is ever wanted, that request reopens as its own card with C's shape — nothing is left pending here.

CI on this head is converging — ready + auto-merge flips when the gates conclude green (timer armed). Card closes on merge; `pm:dispatched` comes off then. #4695 graded on its own card.
